name: M4 Conversation and intervention
intro: The status line, the focused job, the catch-up, unsent text and a second attach; take, release and the intervention record; the modal allow-list; and recordings with replay. The milestone table and the accepted documents settle it, so there is no question; review it and accept or annotate. When you accept it I commit it and start M5 Concurrency and limits.
notes: The demo path is S7's decision and intervention parts, as decided on the 00 board; pausing, resuming and cancelling jobs complete S7 in M5.
Ghostty is qualified locally from M4, with C9; over SSH it is qualified in M7, with C47.
The allow-list starts empty, so M4 delivers the mechanism and the hold; modals are added to it only as they are qualified.
